title: Lake Elune'ara
wikitext:
[[Image:Lake Elune'ara.jpg|thumb|Lake Elune'ara]]
'''Lake Elune'ara''' is a large body of water in [[Moonglade]]. It is the largest lake on the continent of [[Kalimdor]].{{fact}}

The mad [[demigod]] [[Omen (boss)|Omen]], defeated many centuries ago, yet resides in Lake Elune'ara. 

Young [[druid]]s must find relics on the lake's bottom early in their quest to learn their [[Aquatic Form]].
